articles.title: A Tiny Swimming Robot Powered by Living Muscle
articles.summary: MIT's gum-sized robot swims with light-controlled living muscle, showing how soft robots could one day explore delicate places.

articles.title: Netflix Celebrates 10 Years of Korean Stories in Seoul
articles.summary: Netflix marked 10 years in Korea with stars, fans, and previews of new shows, celebrating how far Korean stories have traveled.

articles.title: 149 Tiny Speakers, One Very Loud Wall
articles.summary: WIRED chained 149 of IKEA's $10 speakers into a wall of sound that worked, got very loud, and proved a fun point about cheap tech.
